sources: Council of Europe CEFR spoken-language and phonology resources
ACTFL Proficiency Guidelines, Can-Do Statements, and OPI overview
Lyster and Saito 2010 oral corrective feedback meta-analysis

evidence_gaps: No longitudinal learner data across multiple completed cycles
No stored audio benchmark for pronunciation reliability
Live capabilities vary by account and product version
notes: The research supports a rubric ready for user confirmation, but not automatic freezing. At least one real Live session is recommended before baseline scoring.
